question_evidence_ledger.title: Eisomer/nu, mean tau vs T1/2, natural linewidth vs Q, and intrinsic properties vs operable clocks
minimal_equations: Delta nu_0 = Gamma_0 / h = 1 / (2 pi tau) = ln(2) / (2 pi T_{1/2})
Q = nu_0 / Delta nu_0 = 2 pi nu_0 tau = E_0 / Gamma_0
question_evidence_ledger.distinction: Natural Q is an upper bound on coherence in an isolated two-level system; an operable clock requires a narrow laser oscillator, frequency discriminator with adequate SNR, servo feedback loop, and traceability chain. In solid state, operating Q is ~ 10^11 due to inhomogeneous broadening (27 kHz), but clock operation is achieved by exploiting 10^14 ensemble absorbers to provide high bandwidth (12 kHz modulation) feedback.

question_evidence_ledger.title: Decay channels across neutral atoms, isolated ions, and crystal hosts; non-sufficiency of bandgap > En

key_findings.neutral_atom: IP_1 = 6.307 eV < E_n = 8.36 eV; internal conversion dominates, alpha_IC ~ 10^9, T1/2 = 7 +/- 1 mus.
key_findings.isolated_3plus_ion: IP_4 = 28.8 eV >> E_n; IC forbidden by energy conservation; pure radiative decay dominates, T1/2 = 1400 (+600/-300) s.
key_findings.crystal_matrix: Bandgap Eg (CaF2: 11.8 eV, MgF2: 12.4 eV) > E_n suppresses valence-to-conduction IC; refractive index n ~ 1.5 increases radiative rate by n^3 ~ 3.375, shortening lifetime to ~ 600 s.
key_findings.why_bandgap_is_not_sufficient: Bandgap > E_n is strictly necessary, not sufficient. Interstitial F- and charge compensation create localized electronic defect states and color centers inside the bandgap; non-radiative quenching, electron bridge through defect levels, radiation damage from alpha decay, and inhomogeneous EFG broadening (kHz) drastically reduce coherence time T2* to ~ 10 mus.

question_evidence_ledger.title: Huang et al. 2026 exact measurements: Allan instability, systematic uncertainty, absolute frequency, and inter-crystal difference

strict_separations.allan_instability: sigma_y(tau) = 5 x 10^-13 / sqrt(tau/s) for optimized TS1 + phototube, representing short-term statistical averaging precision under white frequency noise, within 2x of photon shot noise limit (3 x 10^-13 / sqrt(tau/s)).
strict_separations.systematic_uncertainty: Evaluated specifically for temperature: 185 Hz (fractional 9.1 x 10^-14) arising from 0.1 K absolute temperature sensor uncertainty propagated through line b temperature slope.
strict_separations.inter_crystal_difference: Delta nu = 5.6(13) x 10^2 Hz = 560(130) Hz, fractional 2.8(6) x 10^-13, where absolute 0.1 K sensor error cancels common-mode.
strict_separations.absolute_frequencies: Determined via optical frequency comb and hydrogen maser calibrated against UTC.
strict_separations.locking_demonstration: Continuous-wave 148.4 nm laser locked to line b using 12 kHz frequency modulation absorption spectroscopy with phototube.
strict_separations.superlatives_retraction: No ungrounded claims of 'latest' or 'world first'; contextualized with simultaneous publication of Toscani De Col et al. 2026 (Nature 658, 897).

question_evidence_ledger.title: Model dependence of K_alpha and K_q; invalidity of naive eV division
minimal_equations: Delta E_C = -485 MeV * (Delta <r^2> / <r^2>) + 11.6 MeV * (Delta Q_0 / Q_0)
question_evidence_ledger.physics_breakdown: The naive argument Delta E / E ~ 1 MeV / 8 eV ~ 10^5 fails because the isomer transition is an uncharged valence neutron transition (5/2+[633] <-> 3/2+[631]). In a frozen proton core, Delta E_C is strictly zero. Non-zero Delta E_C arises purely from core polarization. Hyperfine data from Thielking 2018 yield Delta E_C = -0.29 +/- 0.43 MeV, whose 1-sigma uncertainty spans zero and allows Delta E_C < 10 keV. Specific nuclear models (Fadeev 2020) obtain K_alpha = -0.9(3) x 10^4 by correlating charge radius and quadrupole changes. Strong interaction sensitivity K_q varies across nuclear EDF models by orders of magnitude (10^3 to 10^5) and can even flip sign.

question_evidence_ledger.title: Necessary conditions for cross-region transfer to A ~ 130 and invalidity of prolate + high/low-j crossing as sufficient law
necessary_conditions: Energy match: Transition energy must fall in laser-accessible optical/VUV window (< 15 eV) or coherent XFEL window.
Favorable EM matrix element: Must be moderately hindered (e.g. B(M1) ~ 10^-2 W.u.) to provide narrow linewidth without making excitation cross section vanishingly small.
Electronic/chemical host compatibility: Host bandgap or ion ionization potential must exceed E_n, with high optical transparency, low defect density, and radiation hardness.
Production and sample preparation window: Long-lived parent or high-yield reaction channel must exist to accumulate sufficient nuclei (e.g. 10^14 for crystals, or continuous ion trap feeding).
question_evidence_ledger.why_crossing_is_not_sufficient: In A ~ 130 and other deformed regions, high-j intruder (h11/2) and low-j (d5/2, g7/2) orbitals cross as beta2 and gamma vary, but their energy differences are typically 100 keV to 1 MeV. Furthermore, high-j to low-j transitions involve opposite parity or large Delta j (M4, E3), resulting in keV-range high-spin isomers rather than eV-range optical transitions. In 229Th, the degeneracy is an accidental cancellation between two positive-parity Nilsson states (5/2+[633] and 3/2+[631]) within the same N=6 oscillator shell. Single-particle models cannot predict eV-scale splittings, making prolate + orbital crossing neither necessary nor sufficient for low-energy nuclear clocks.

corrections_ledger.old_note_text: Failure Conditions 1: 如果固态晶体温度梯度大于 mK 量级或受到非均匀应变扰动，四极劈裂谱线的漂移（~kHz/K）将破坏时钟长期稳定度。
corrections_ledger.rectification: Retracted. The 3 mK figure in Huang 2026 (p. 907) was the empirical root-mean-square temporal temperature fluctuation of their specific laboratory temperature control loop during that run, not a universal threshold. Line b exhibits a quadratic temperature dependence with a turning point near room temperature (~301.4 K), resulting in a vanishing linear slope, which is precisely why line b was chosen. No physical mK failure gate exists.

corrections_ledger.old_note_text: Falsification 1: 若未来跨实验室采用不同生长工艺制备的 229Th:CaF2 晶体进行零漂移比对时，绝对频差显著超出四极场不均匀估计（> 10 kHz），则证伪固态晶体作为独立可复现基准的可行性。
corrections_ledger.rectification: Retracted. The > 10 kHz figure was completely fabricated without citation. Huang 2026 (p. 907) demonstrated that independently grown crystals (S1 and TS1) differ by only 560(130) Hz (2.8 x 10^-13), and agree with JILA C10/C13 data within combined 1.22 kHz uncertainty. The inhomogeneous linewidth of line b is 27(1) kHz. No 10 kHz falsification gate exists in primary literature.

corrections_ledger.old_note_text: Transfer Conditions 2: 只要宿主晶体满足禁带宽度显著大于核跃迁能，且掺杂核处于高配位局部对称格点，原子核即可在凝聚态介质中维持长寿命与低退相干...
corrections_ledger.rectification: Corrected from sufficient ('只要...即可') to necessary. Host bandgap > E_n only suppresses valence-to-conduction band internal conversion. It does NOT guarantee long radiative lifetime or long coherence due to interstitial charge compensation defects, color centers, radiation damage, non-radiative quenching, electronic bridge mechanisms, and inhomogeneous quadrupole broadening.

corrections_ledger.old_note_text: Falsification 3: 若 Toscani De Col 2026 报告的暗物质排除边界在独立核钟或单离子核钟比对中出现正信号但不具备恒星时/周年多普勒调制特征，则判定为环境微扰引起的伪信号。
corrections_ledger.rectification: Retracted. Dark matter searches via optical clocks look for coherent oscillations of fundamental constants (e.g. alpha) at the Compton frequency of ultralight fields or transient topological defect passages. Evaluating signals requires multi-clock ratio comparisons across systems with differing K_alpha sensitivities, phase coherence checks, and Doppler modulation analysis, rather than an arbitrary binary dismissal threshold.

corrections_ledger.issue: Infinite blocking fallacy (未决参数无限门)
corrections_ledger.old_note_text: Implicitly treating unresolved single-ion clocking, crystal field shifts at 10^-18, and exact empirical K_alpha as blockers for thesis readiness.
corrections_ledger.rectification: Clarified that ongoing metrology challenges (single-ion sub-Hz clocking, 10^-18 systematic uncertainty budgets, empirical determination of K_alpha) are active research frontiers. Foundational doctoral understanding requires mastering the underlying physical mechanisms, environmental coupling channels, and model dependencies, rather than awaiting future experimental resolution of all open frontiers.

doctoral_readiness_assessment.stage_one_understanding: Achieved. Complete physical clarity established across: (1) energy scales, natural vs operational Q, M1/E2 multipolarity; (2) electronic environmental decay channels (IC, EB, non-radiative quenching, local field effects); (3) Huang 2026 operational clock demonstration and metrological boundaries; (4) core-polarization model dependence of fundamental constant sensitivities; and (5) cross-region transfer constraints.
doctoral_readiness_assessment.open_frontiers_distinction: Unresolved experimental parameters (e.g., trapped ion 3+ closed-loop lock, sub-Hz systematic budgets) are properly categorized as active scientific research questions, not as blockers for thesis design.
